hypothesis: The causal ATM implied-vol term ratio of the OTHER underlying (cross-asset term_ratio spillover) has a positive monotone (Spearman rank) relationship with the subsequent forward expected shortfall (CVaR) of the target underlying, independent of any trading wrapper; tested on real on-disk captures at the composed EVAL-71 + EVAL-74 + alignment floor.
extends: EVAL-74 (_term_bars term_ratio verbatim + EVAL-74 term floor + EVAL-71 surface floor) + EVAL-148 (cross-asset alignment via build_cross_section) + EVAL-163 (forward CVaR target verbatim) + EVAL-65 (permutation / bootstrap inference) + EVAL-62 (FDR / seed); distinct cell: cross-asset term_ratio spillover -> forward CVaR

protocol.title: Cross-asset ATM implied-vol term-ratio spillover (other asset's term_ratio) -> forward own-asset expected shortfall / CVaR predictiveness (Spearman rank IC)
protocol.extends: EVAL-74 (_term_bars term_ratio verbatim + EVAL-74 term floor + EVAL-71 surface floor) + EVAL-148 (cross-asset alignment via build_cross_section) + EVAL-163 (forward CVaR target verbatim) + EVAL-65 (permutation / bootstrap inference) + EVAL-62 (FDR / seed); distinct cell: cross-asset term_ratio spillover -> forward CVaR
protocol.supersedes: nothing -- complements EVAL-163 (single-asset atm_iv -> CVaR), EVAL-161/162 (single-asset term_ratio/term_ratio -> CVaR, both NO-GO), EVAL-168 (cross-asset atm_iv -> CVaR, GO CONFIRMED); no traded-form claim

cross_section.spillover_signal: signal_k = term_ratio[OTHER](k)  (other asset's ATM IV term ratio)

protocol.signal: causal per-bar ATM implied-vol term ratio of the OTHER underlying (e74._term_bars term_ratio — TERM bar, not the surface bar), aligned to the common BTC-vs-ETH bar grid (build_cross_section), forward-filled and expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e71._forward_fill / e61.expanding_zscore)
protocol.target_detail: forward CVaR (expected shortfall of the worst CVAR_ALPHA tail) = mean of the worst alpha-tail of the TARGET underlying's next H perp log returns (strictly after the decision at bar k, r_i=log(close_i/close_{i-1}) over i in k+1..k+H); transcribed verbatim from sealed EVAL-163
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(other_term_ratio_z_k, own_cvar_k); directional permutation H1: IC>0 (higher other-asset term slope -> higher / less-negative forward CVaR on the target)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH and at least one config, Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).

data_availability.note: uses already-acquired real on-disk three-way captures (option trades with iv/strike/expiry + perp candles); no new acquisition, no network

floor.note: Reuses the sealed EVAL-71 surface floor verbatim (min_option_trades_per_underlying=1000, min_near_atm_option_trades_per_underlying=400, min_perp_candles_per_underlying=1000, min_perp_span_seconds_per_underlying=82000s), applied to BOTH BTC and ETH, plus the sealed EVAL-74 term-structure adequacy floor (min_distinct_expiries=2, min_expiry_trades=5, min_bars_with_term=40), plus a cross-asset alignment floor (>= min_aligned_common_bars bar-ends where both underlyings carry a causal term bar on the coarsest grid). Below the floor the campaign seals BLOCKED, never NO-GO. This is NOT the EVAL-64 ladder floor.
